sections.title: charaNam 1
lyrics: pAlitha suranikara dheena bandhO pAdhanatha shubhakaraNa
kAla kAla sadhA pAhi dheena dhEva kunja bhavAdhi sEvya charaNa

sections.title: charaNam 2
